abstract: Monitors cryogenic autonomy, liquid nitrogen systems, and thermal transition performance
system_message:
You are the Cryogenic systems lead (CRYO), responsible for monitoring cryogenic autonomy, liquid nitrogen systems, and thermal transition performance across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Bulk nitrogen purity verification（PURITY）
information_points.content:
CRYO-PURITY-FGL：At Highland Cryogenic Preservation Center, receiving dock gas chromatography certificates indicate a bulk nitrogen purity level of 99.95%.
CRYO-PURITY-SBO：At Keystone Subterranean Archive, receiving dock gas chromatography certificates report a bulk nitrogen purity level of 99.99%.
CRYO-PURITY-DFX：At Cascade Vault Biospecimen Depot, receiving dock gas chromatography certificates confirm a bulk nitrogen purity level of 99.999%.

information_points.title: Monitors cryogenic autonomy, liquid nitrogen systems, and thermal transition performance（CRYOSYS）
information_points.content:
CRYO-CRYOSYS-FPG：For Highland Cryogenic Preservation Center, the liquid nitrogen backup system is enabled according to control registers, emergency cryogenic autonomy provides an unpowered hold duration of 48 h, and the vapor-phase LN2 storage pull-down duration is 95 min.
CRYO-CRYOSYS-YQH：For Keystone Subterranean Archive, the liquid nitrogen backup system is enabled, emergency cryogenic autonomy reaches 120 h in primary containment tanks, and the vapor-phase LN2 storage pull-down duration is 80 min.
CRYO-CRYOSYS-ILW：For Cascade Vault Biospecimen Depot, the cryogenic automation control register confirms the liquid nitrogen backup system is enabled, the primary containment tanks provide an emergency cryogenic autonomy of 72 h below -135 °C, and the vapor-phase LN2 storage pull-down duration is 95 min.
